name: Johny Takkedasila

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Johny Takkedasila is a Telugu poet, fiction writer, critic and translator from Pulivendula, Andhra Pradesh, whose writing also spans Hindi and English. His Telugu critical work Vivechani received the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar in 2023. His books include Nadaka, published by Ukiyoto.

In “Sometimes I Freeze,” emotional paralysis becomes stone, wounded breath and a body struggling to move. Blood, tears, fire and rain carry the poem through a series of transformations, until its closing address joins pain with gratitude toward the person who sets the speaker in motion.
